dct_description_sm: Vision H2O is a watershed group working on maintaining a healthy ecosystem and to conserve healthy water in the Village of Cap-Pelé and the Beaubassin-est rural community. We collaborate with many local organizations, municipalities and other environmental organization to help educate our local citizen on different environmental issue in our community. Our water quality monitoring program is one of our many annual project. Water quality data is collected by our YSI and grab samples that are sent to a laboratory to be analyse.
